source_papers.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
Machine Learning for Basketball Game Outcomes: NBA and WNBA Leagues

motivation: Nature 2025 stacked ensemble (NB+AdaBoost+MLP+KNN+XGB+DT+LR) reveals two CPU-viable model types missing from our GA pool: AdaBoost and GaussianNB. MDPI 2026 uncertainty-aware paper shows LR reaching Brier=0.199 with rolling-form indicators + spatial shot-chart embeddings — our LR islands (S15 0.22325, S17 0.22289) have a 0.024 gap best addressed via feature engineering, not calibration.

fleet_context.s14_top5_internal: 0.21966-0.22105 with extra_trees/RF post-diversify — promising internal signal

proposals.title: Add AdaBoost as GA model type
proposals.description: Add sklearn.ensemble.AdaBoostClassifier with n_estimators∈[50,200] and learning_rate∈[0.05,1.0] to the island GA MODEL_TYPES pool. AdaBoost uses a different inductive bias than gradient boosting (XGB/LGB) and random forests — adds population diversity. Fits in ~2s on CPU for 30K games.

changes: Wrap with CalibratedClassifierCV(cv=5, method='sigmoid') for probability calibration
implementation.test_island: S14 (post-diversify, most diverse — gen 543, extra_trees dominant)

proposals.title: Audit + expand rolling-form feature group in features/engine.py
proposals.description: MDPI 2026 shows LR Brier=0.199 uses rolling-form indicators as a key feature group. Our feature engine v3.1 has 54 categories / ~7213 candidates. Audit to confirm rolling-form coverage. If missing: last_5_win_pct, last_10_win_pct, home_away_form_split_last5, point_diff_trend_7d, opponent_form_last_5. These are the highest-value gap fillers to close the 0.023 LR Brier gap.

changes: If <5 rolling-form features exist: add as new category (target: 5-10 features)
Features: last_5_win_pct, last_10_win_pct, last_5_home_win_pct, last_5_away_win_pct, point_diff_last5_avg, opponent_last5_win_pct, back_to_back_flag, days_rest
implementation.parity_note: Must update both features/engine.py AND hf-space/features/engine.py — run engine parity check after

proposals.title: Add GaussianNB as fast diversity seed in GA
proposals.description: GaussianNB fits in <0.1s, solo Brier ~0.25 but contributes to stacking diversity. Useful as a meta-learner input in venn_abers_fusion islands (S22). Nature 2025 uses NB as one of 7 base learners.

changes: GaussianNB() — no calibration wrapper needed (probabilistic by design)

proposals.expected_brier_improvement: Negligible solo; useful as stacking base learner

immediate_action: P2 (rolling-form audit) is highest impact and non-breaking. DR FRANKENSTEIN should audit features/engine.py category list for rolling-form coverage before next evolution cycle. P1 (AdaBoost) is safe to A/B test on S14.
